access_condition: white-box-aware (true encoder granted) — strictly stronger than the base matrix's matched access; NOT comparable as a matched-access row
utility_source: carried verbatim from the base cell; the attack cannot change training-time utility

calibration.source: public calibration partition of the 96-article development corpus

access.public_head: pretrained public head exported before victim training (split{N}/public-head-{seed}.pt)
access.public_defense_decoder: granted when the defense exposes a cloud decoder (bottleneck v2 geometry, pca-compress basis)

defense_aware_arm.knowledge: defense CLASS and released width k only (no defense weights or randomness)
defense_aware_arm.surrogate: PCA encoder+inverse fit on the public calibration partition at the same k
defense_aware_arm.use: learned prior over the observed wire for the forward/beam/SIPIT kernels (BPDA-style straight-through approximation)

access.observations: post-defense training-phase fwd wire captures plus canonical scoring truth (scoring only)

query_budgets.ridge_fit: one pass over the public calibration partition

whitebox_extension.granted: the defended cell's ACTUAL trained defense checkpoint and provenance sidecar (encoder weights for tb-*, fitted PCA basis for pca-compress), in addition to everything the defense-aware surrogate arm holds
whitebox_extension.strength: strictly stronger than the surrogate arm's defense-class + k + public-calibration knowledge
whitebox_extension.rationale: mirrors the defense framework's assumption that the current transform is necessarily visible to the executor

arms.whitebox_inverter: MLP inverse of the TRUE defense map trained on public-calibration activations pushed through the true encoder; forward-beam + SIPIT on the reconstruction
arms.whitebox_optimization: Adam input optimization against the frozen true encoder's input-output map (steps_per_wire = the sweep's SIPIT steps budget), decoded via the public head

whitebox_extension.caveat: white-box recovery is measured under strictly stronger access; it does not constrain black-box recovery of the same wire, nor the surrogate arm or any defense-internals-hidden adversary

inverter.trained_on: public calibration pushed through the TRUE defense map

whitebox_optimization.objective: match the released z by optimizing continuous seam inputs through the frozen true encoder (Adam)
whitebox_optimization.budget_match: one encoder-side optimization budget equal to the sweep's SIPIT step count, replacing per-token head optimization
